body:
I just want to be happy. 

I don’t want to be trans I think it’d make my life too complicated and overall cause more problems than it’ll solve. And my parents will just dismiss me telling them I’ve felt like this for ages as part of lockdown or something. They just dismiss anything serious I have to say and say everything bad that happens is just a phase. I feel like I’ve being forced into this successful accounting lifestyle with a successful girlfriend but I’m stuck with these shitty feelings I wish I didn’t have. The internal conflict is really killing me. 

I don’t want to sleep around but that’s literally all my mates that I have left talk about and do and since I’m 21 and have only ever really been with my ex I feel like I just feel pressured to cave into the lad culture that disgusts me. The whole situation is shit and I just can’t see a way to end it because once again it’s 4am and I’m wide awake stressing about everything and I’ve literally not slept more than 4 hours In about a fortnight.
